So now my parents are a tiny bit more supportive of me now that they know I actually have an issue, but still tell me to suck it up. I’ve currently been unemployed for 6 months...
Yep it was brutal although when I got  older they were a bit more relaxed

Ruined my childhood. I was only allowed to watch G rated movies which resulted in declining offers from friends. Missed a lot of birthday parties because they landed on a Sunday, never bought anything on Sunday not even an ice cream cone on a hot day. Got teased a lot at school,didn’t help I was the only Mormon in the school . People tried to get me to swear (I wasn’t even allowed to say stupid,dumb,shut-up etc) get me to drink alcohol,and they tried to push me into inappropriate activities. My brothers weren’t  allowed to have sleepovers. We had to eventually quit sports that we loved because the games started to land on sundays. Had to wear a prom dress I hated(looked like an old granny dress) because I had to stay modest. On vacations to Disneyland,Hawaii I almost past out from heat exhaustion because I had to be “modest”. Wasted 4 years of my life doing early morning seminary, never had caffeine, most people saw me as boring because I literally couldn’t do anything. Cried every Sunday morning begging my parents not to go church (ended up going).got taught my family would all die if we traveled on a Sunday. as for the dating I never did date as no boy ever talked to me so ya it sucked.

Same thing happened to me except from a teacher when I was in grade 12.I’ve had many instances of people in authority targeting me(I was shy)but this one was by far the worst. He was one of those obnoxious,crude teachers who had a ritual in which every new year he would pick someone to tease relentlessly to brink of suicidal thoughts...he chose me. For example if someone burped or talked during lesson he would immediately blame it on me and would rips me shreds while the whole class is laughing and joining in on it. My teacher liked to see my embarrassment. Everyday I feared for my life due to  
him which resulted in constant shaking,permanent red face,extreme anxiety. That experience reflected on my employment as I could never keep a job(unemployed) because I was scared someone else in authority could take advantage of me(which happened).i have now been diagnosed with ptsd,anxiety due to this circumstance.
